notes.title: Sales transfer and Game Updates
notes.content:
Hello, 

This is Henteko Doujin.
We are pleased to announce that we have been transfered the sales of the ALLTYNEX Trilogy from Nyu Media.

Along with the transfer, we have updated the games as follows:

[b]ALLTYNEX Second、RefleX、KAMUI[/b]
- The Japanese version is now included in the games. (Especially the Japanese visual representation of KAMUI is cool, so check it out!)
- The publisher logo of the games have been changed to Henteko Doujin.
- The soundtrack now includes high-quality FLAC data.
- The soundtracks are now compatible with the Steam client's music player.

[b]RefleX[/b]
- Fixed display issues on Windows 10 or later.

[b]Thank you for your continued support![/b]
